concept.concept: Illustrated cross-section of a perfectly scored sourdough loaf with the caption 'Fed the Starter, Skipped the Gym' in hand-lettered style
concept.audience: Home sourdough bakers aged 25-45 who are active in bread-baking communities online
concept.rationale: Sourdough baking became a lifestyle identity during pandemic years and has maintained a dedicated community, self-deprecating humor resonates strongly, and the niche has a passionate buyer base with real gift-giving occasions

design.image_prompt: The design prominently features the text "Fed the Starter, Skipped the Gym" — spelled exactly, large and readable, integrated into the composition, no other words anywhere. Flat vector illustration of a sourdough loaf cross-section showing a perfectly scored top with dramatic ear, interior crumb structure with irregular open holes, golden-brown crust. Centered composition. Solid color blocks, no gradients, no airbrush shading, no photorealism. Bold simple shapes, clean sharp edges, screen-print aesthetic. High contrast. Limited palette: warm golden tan, deep brown, cream, charcoal gray, sage green. Plain solid cream background, generous margin, all artwork elements centered and away from edges.
design.text_on_design: Fed the Starter, Skipped the Gym
design.style: Hand-lettered chunky lowercase sans-serif in charcoal gray, arched below the sourdough cross-section, casual confident letterforms with slight stroke variation

verdict.reason: The phrase 'Fed the Starter, Skipped the Gym' is an original, generic humorous expression combining common sourdough baking terminology with a relatable lifestyle sentiment. It does not reference any known trademark, brand, celebrity, sports team, song lyric, movie or TV quote, or protected slogan. The illustrated sourdough loaf cross-section is a generic food depiction with no proprietary character or logo association. This is the type of common observational humor that is widely considered safe for print-on-demand use.

image_verdict.reason: Text reads exactly 'FED THE STARTER, SKIPPED THE GYM' — correctly spelled and complete. The illustration is a generic sourdough bread loaf cross-section, no IP concerns. Clean composition on a plain background suitable for garment printing. No quality issues detected.

listing.title: Sourdough Starter Mug | Fed the Starter, Skipped Gym
listing.description: A mug for dedicated home sourdough bakers who understand the commitment. Features an illustrated cross-section of a perfectly scored sourdough loaf with hand-lettered text reading 'Fed the Starter, Skipped the Gym.' It's a nod to the daily ritual of maintaining your starter and the priorities of bread-baking life. Dishwasher and microwave safe ceramic. Perfect for bakers in online bread-making communities, or gift it to that friend obsessed with sourdough.
